title: Email address uniqueness validation
gherkin:
Feature: Unique email address
  Scenario: User tries to register with an existing email address
    Given a user with email "test@example.com" already exists
    When a new user tries to register with email "test@example.com"
    Then the registration should fail with an error message "Email address already in use"
rationale: To verify that the system prevents duplicate email registrations, ensuring each email is unique.
generationSummary: Tests to ensure that email addresses are unique within the system.

title: Successful registration with unique email
gherkin:
Feature: Unique email address
  Scenario: User registers with a unique email address
    Given no user exists with email "unique@example.com"
    When a new user registers with email "unique@example.com"
    Then the registration should succeed
rationale: To confirm that the system allows registration when the email is unique, fulfilling the requirement.
generationSummary: Tests to ensure that email addresses are unique within the system.

title: Email address uniqueness during update

title: Email address uniqueness in bulk registration
gherkin:
Feature: Unique email address
  Scenario: Bulk registration with duplicate emails
    Given a list of emails includes "duplicate@example.com" twice
    When a bulk registration is attempted with these emails
    Then the registration should fail with an error message "Duplicate email addresses found"
rationale: To test that the system can handle bulk registrations while enforcing email uniqueness.
generationSummary: Tests to ensure that email addresses are unique within the system.

title: Email address uniqueness in password recovery
gherkin:
Feature: Unique email address

    When a user tries to recover password for email "nonexistent@example.com"
    Then the recovery should fail with an error message "Email address not found"
rationale: To ensure that the system checks for email existence and uniqueness during password recovery processes.
generationSummary: Tests to ensure that email addresses are unique within the system.

title: Email address uniqueness in notifications
gherkin:
Feature: Unique email address
  Scenario: Sending notifications to duplicate email addresses
    Given two users with the same email "duplicate@example.com"
    When a notification is sent to "duplicate@example.com"
    Then the notification should be sent only once
rationale: To verify that the system handles notifications correctly when duplicate emails exist, ensuring no duplicate notifications are sent.
generationSummary: Tests to ensure that email addresses are unique within the system.

title: Email address uniqueness in user login
gherkin:
Feature: Unique email address

    Given two users with the same email "duplicate@example.com"

rationale: To ensure that the system allows login for users with unique email addresses, even if duplicates exist in the database.
